style: High-quality anime film still, modern Japanese action RPG look inspired by Zenless Zone Zero: thin clean line art, detailed anime illustration, flat two-tone cel shading, soft rim light, vivid color grading, smooth camera motion, 16:9, consistent character design.
negative: photorealistic, live action, 3D render plastic look, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, blurry, low resolution, flicker, frame jitter, manga, comic book, thick ink outlines, western cartoon, modern buildings

characters.Erin: Erin, young female mage scribe, shoulder-length silver-lilac hair, violet eyes, deep purple hooded coat with gold trim, leather satchel of scrolls, carved wooden staff with a glowing violet orb
characters.Player: the hero seen from behind or in silhouette, hooded traveler cloak, face never shown
characters.Laoyan: Laoyan, elderly bell keeper of the fire village, white hair and long white beard, red work robe, leaning on a wooden walking staff
characters.Xiaotie: Xiaotie, energetic teenage miner boy, spiky brown hair, red headband, orange goggles on forehead, soot on cheek, brown apron
characters.Cui: Cui, elderly elf woman, long pale-green white hair, green robe with leaf ornaments, calm wise eyes
characters.Xiaoye: Xiaoye, small elf child, green twin tails, yellow tunic, holding a wooden story tablet
characters.Haido: Haido, young sea captain, dark navy short hair, white captain cap, blue naval coat with gold anchor pin
characters.Nagi: Nagi, gentle young woman, short wine-red hair, pink dress with white apron, small gold earring, holding a lantern
characters.Mio: Mio, ghostly singer of the old ship, translucent pale blue figure, long flowing hair, soft glowing outline
characters.Golem: the Lava Colossus, a 3-meter golem of cracked black basalt with glowing orange magma veins, a black crystal lodged in its chest
characters.TreeKing: the Corrupted Tree King, a towering tree creature with twisted bark limbs, glowing purple spores, a black crystal binding its heart
characters.Kraken: the Abyssal Kraken, a colossal sea monster with deep teal skin, glowing cyan runes, huge tentacles, a black crystal engraved with names on its chest
characters.Wraith: the Demon Swordsman Wraith, a player-sized humanoid undead knight in shattered black plate armor, violet-magenta ghost fire burning in the armor gaps and the empty visor, a long cape torn into strips of black mist, a black longsword with magenta light flowing along the blade, the other hand a clawed gauntlet wreathed in ghost fire, lean agile swordsman stance (not a giant)
characters.Castle: a gothic European castle throne room at night: tall stone pillars, red-and-gold banners, candelabras, a stained-glass rose window glowing violet behind a dark throne, suits of armor along the walls

videos.title: 序章：晨鐘啞了
videos.play: 第一次進入故事地圖時（約 40 秒）

shots.zh: 清晨的火山村落全景，灰燼像雪一樣落下，鐘樓上的大鐘靜止不動。
shots.prompt: wide establishing shot of a volcanic mountain village at dawn, ash falling like snow, an old stone bell tower with a large bronze bell hanging still, warm orange sky, slow push-in, rustic stone and timber houses with tiled roofs, no modern buildings

shots.zh: 鐘樓內部特寫：鐘舌斷了一截，鐘身爬著黑色結晶。
shots.prompt: close-up inside the bell tower, the bronze bell's clapper is broken in half, creeping black crystal veins on the bell surface, dust in light beams, slow orbit

shots.zh: 老焰站在空蕩的廣場，拄杖抬頭望著不響的鐘。
shots.prompt: {Laoyan} standing alone in an empty village square, looking up at the silent bell tower, ash drifting, melancholic, medium shot, gentle wind in his beard

shots.zh: 旅人（玩家背影）走上村口石階，斗篷被風吹起。
shots.prompt: {Player} walking up stone steps toward the village gate, cloak billowing in hot wind, camera behind at shoulder height, embers floating

shots.zh: 艾琳從書卷中抬頭，對旅人微笑，法杖寶珠亮起。
shots.prompt: {Erin} sits in the dusty village archive at dawn, warm light falling through a tall window behind her and shelves of scrolls around her; she looks up from an open scroll and smiles at the viewer as her staff orb lights up with violet glow, medium close-up, soft rim light

shots.zh: 遠方山腹裂縫透出紅光，傳來三下敲擊聲（畫面隨聲音震一下）。
shots.prompt: wide shot of a distant volcanic mountainside, a long glowing red lava fissure splits the dark rock, the red glow pulses three times as the ground trembles and loose stones roll down the slope, the camera shakes slightly, ash drifting in the air, ominous atmosphere, pure landscape, no people, no vehicles

shots.zh: 三座鐘的剪影依序亮起：火山、森林、海港（伏筆），最後熄滅。
shots.prompt: symbolic montage of three scenes shown one after another: first a bronze bell in a stone tower on a volcano under an orange sky lights up with a golden glow, then a bronze bell hanging from a giant tree in a misty green forest lights up, then a bronze bell on a lighthouse at a seaside harbor lights up, finally all three fade to darkness, mystical and quiet, pure landscape, no people

shots.zh: 艾琳與旅人並肩走向冒煙的礦坑口，標題浮現前的空鏡。
shots.prompt: {Erin} and {Player} walking side by side toward a smoking mine entrance, backs to camera, sunrise behind the volcano, epic wide shot, leave empty space at top for a title

videos.title: 第一章終：熔岩巨像・守門人的拳
videos.play: 1-4 開打前（約 30 秒）與通關後（約 20 秒），可拆成兩段

shots.zh: 熔岩大廳，巨像守在石閘前，胸口黑晶脈動。
shots.prompt: {Golem} guarding a massive stone gate in a magma hall, the black crystal in its chest pulsing, low angle hero shot, lava rivers glowing

shots.zh: 巨像眼睛亮起，低聲說「封住……所有的路」，熔岩從身上流下。
shots.prompt: close-up of {Golem}'s face, eyes ignite bright orange, magma drips from its jaw, slow menacing turn toward camera

shots.zh: 艾琳舉杖擋在前方，喊「攔住牠！」，旅人拔劍。
shots.prompt: {Erin} raises her staff defensively, violet barrier sparks, {Player} draws a weapon beside her, dynamic low angle, heat haze

shots.zh: 巨像高舉雙拳砸地，衝擊波捲起火星。
shots.prompt: inside the magma hall in front of the massive stone gate, {Golem} raises both fists and slams the ground, a ring shockwave of embers and molten rock bursts outward, camera shake, slow motion

shots.zh: （通關）黑晶碎裂，巨像緩緩跪下，熔岩轉暗。
shots.prompt: the black crystal in {Golem}'s chest shatters into glowing shards, the colossus drops to one knee and lowers its head, the orange glow in its magma veins slowly fades to dim ember, emotional, slow motion

shots.zh: 艾琳把鐘舌扣回大鐘，鐘聲響起，金色聲波掃過整座山。
shots.prompt: {Erin} lifts the bell's broken iron striker and fits it back inside the great bronze bell, the bell rings, golden sound waves sweep across the volcano and village, triumphant sunrise

videos.title: 第二章終：腐化樹王・不肯入睡的心

shots.zh: 霧中的記名林，古樹上掛著無數刻名木牌。
shots.prompt: a misty ancient forest where countless small wooden name tags hang from giant trees, soft green light rays, quiet and sacred, slow dolly forward

shots.zh: 樹王從祭壇的根中站起，紫色孢子飄散。
shots.prompt: a massive corrupted tree monster, {TreeKing}, slowly rises up out of the tangled roots surrounding an empty stone altar, bark limbs unfolding, purple glowing spores drift, ominous low angle, fog, pure creature shot, no people

shots.zh: 翠與小葉抱著名冊站在後方，艾琳回頭點頭。
shots.prompt: {Cui} and {Xiaoye} stand side by side in the foreground holding a large closed leather-bound book together, no writing visible, {Erin} in front of them glances back over her shoulder and nods reassuringly, all three faces visible, medium shot, dappled forest light

shots.zh: 藤鞭橫掃過來，旅人蹲下閃過。
shots.prompt: a massive vine whip sweeps horizontally toward camera, {Player} ducks low under it, leaves scatter, slow motion action

shots.zh: （通關）黑晶裂開，樹根展平，一顆發光的種子落在名冊上。
shots.prompt: the black crystal binding {TreeKing}'s heart cracks open, roots relax and flatten, a single glowing seed falls gently onto an open book of names, peaceful, golden light

videos.title: 終章：深海巨妖・黎明的三重奏

shots.zh: 暴風夜的港口，舊燈塔的光在雨中掃過。
shots.prompt: stormy night at an old stone harbor town, an ancient weathered stone lighthouse with a sweeping beam, heavy rain, waves crashing on rocks, wooden sailing ships moored at the pier, lantern-lit timber warehouses, fantasy medieval harbor, no modern buildings, no skyscrapers, no city skyline, no apartment blocks, cinematic wide shot

shots.zh: 巨妖攀上礁石，胸前刻滿名字的黑晶發光。
shots.prompt: {Kraken} climbs onto the reef, tentacles coiling around rocks, the name-engraved black crystal on its chest glowing, lightning flash, low angle

shots.zh: 海斗與凪在燈塔下，凪提燈、海斗拔出佩劍。
shots.prompt: {Haido} draws his sword and {Nagi} raises a lantern at the foot of the lighthouse, rain streaming, determined expressions, medium shot

shots.zh: 澪的幽影浮現在浪上，輕聲唱歌，歌聲化成光點。
shots.prompt: {Mio} appears hovering above the waves, singing softly, her voice turns into drifting points of light, ethereal, slow orbit

shots.zh: （結局）黑晶崩散，巨妖沉回深海，雨停。
shots.prompt: the black crystal on {Kraken}'s chest crumbles to sparkling dust, the giant sinks back into the deep sea, the rain stops, clouds part, calm

shots.zh: 三座鐘隔著山、林、海同時響起，晨光灑落。
shots.prompt: triptych landscape, three scenes side by side at the same moment: on the left a stone bell tower on a volcano, in the center a bronze bell hanging from a giant tree in a forest, on the right a bell on an ancient weathered stone harbor lighthouse with wooden sailing ships below, all three bells ringing at once with golden sound waves rippling outward, golden dawn light washing over every scene, triumphant, pure landscape, no people, no modern buildings

shots.zh: 白帆船化成晨光遠去；港口立起歸航者名碑。
shots.prompt: a ghostly white-sailed ship dissolves into morning light on the horizon, villagers gather around a new memorial stone of names at the harbor, emotional wide shot

shots.zh: 艾琳合上紀行，對旅人微笑（片尾）。
shots.prompt: {Erin} closes a leather-bound travel journal and smiles warmly at the viewer, behind her the volcanic village with its stone bell tower and the volcano at sunrise, soft focus, ending shot, no modern buildings, no skyscrapers, no city skyline

videos.title: 月影古堡・魔劍士惡靈
videos.play: 月影古堡（castle_test）走進王座之間、開打前（約 30 秒）；播完接王座之間的對話，敵人才撲過來

shots.zh: 王座之間的燭火一盞接一盞熄滅，只剩王座後方的彩繪玻璃透著紫光。
shots.prompt: {Castle}, candle flames along the hall going out one after another from near to far, darkness creeping toward the throne, only the violet stained-glass window still glowing, slow dolly forward, ominous

shots.zh: 王座上的身影緩緩站起，拖著黑劍，劍尖在石地上劃出火花。
shots.prompt: {Wraith} slowly rising from the dark throne, dragging the black longsword so its tip scrapes sparks across the stone floor, low angle, violet backlight from the stained glass

shots.zh: 特寫：面甲的縫隙裡亮起兩點紫紅冥火。
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of {Wraith}'s empty helmet visor, two points of magenta ghost fire igniting inside the slit, wisps of black mist, slow push in

shots.zh: 惡靈舉劍指向鏡頭（玩家），劍身的紫光流動。
shots.prompt: {Wraith} raising the black longsword and pointing it straight at the camera, magenta light flowing along the blade, cape of black mist billowing, medium shot, {Castle} behind

shots.zh: 牆邊的盔甲、骷髏、石像鬼一個接一個轉過頭，眼裡亮起光。
shots.prompt: {Castle}, along the walls suits of armor, skeleton soldiers and stone gargoyles turning their heads one after another toward the camera, their eyes lighting up red and blue, tracking shot

shots.zh: 惡靈劍一揮，冥火掃過大廳，敵人一起衝過來，畫面衝向鏡頭後淡出。
shots.prompt: {Wraith} sweeping the sword sideways, a crescent of magenta ghost fire racing across the hall, skeletons and armored knights charging toward the camera, fast push in then fade to black

videos.title: 月影古堡・開場
videos.play: 月影古堡（castle_test）第一次進副本、開打前（約 30 秒）；播完直接進地圖

shots.zh: 月亮被雲遮住的夜裡，山丘上那座沒人住的古堡，窗戶一扇一扇亮了起來。
shots.prompt: a gothic castle on a moonlit hill at night, the moon half hidden by clouds, its dark windows lighting up one after another with cold violet light, slow push in from far away, mist over the hill

shots.zh: 村裡的人說，每到這種夜晚，古堡的鐘就會響；聽見鐘聲的人，再也沒有回來。
shots.prompt: a small medieval village at the foot of the hill at night, a distant bell tolling from the castle, a lone villager with a lantern walking in a trance up the hill path, villagers watching fearfully from behind shutters

shots.zh: {玩家}，地圖上沒有這座城堡的名字……書裡只寫了「月影」兩個字。
shots.prompt: {Erin} and {Player} standing before the huge iron-bound castle gate at night, Erin holding an old book open with a faint violet glow, looking up at the gate, moonlight, medium shot

shots.zh: 沉重的城門自己打開了，又在兩人身後「砰」地關上。
shots.prompt: the heavy castle gate creaking open by itself, {Erin} and {Player} stepping into a dark entrance hall with a crystal chandelier, then the gate slamming shut behind them, dust bursting, the candles flaring

shots.zh: 走廊深處傳來喀啦喀啦的骨頭聲。盔甲、骷髏、提燈的幽靈，全都醒了。
shots.prompt: a long gothic corridor with red carpet and portraits, skeleton soldiers rising and turning their heads, an empty suit of armor's visor lighting blue, a hooded ghost with a purple lantern floating out of a wall, bats scattering, tracking shot

shots.zh: 小心腳下——地板的縫裡有東西在發光。這座城堡，到處都是機關。
shots.prompt: close-up of a stone floor tile with thin red light glowing in its seams, steel spikes rising slightly, {Erin} catching {Player}'s arm to stop them, then both raising weapons as the corridor ahead fills with glowing eyes, push in, fade to black
